note: No-Intro SHA1 of Double Dragon (1988) (Technos).nes from the user's ROM library (<library>/Double Dragon (1988) (Technos).nes), computed with the README's own command - python3 -c "import sys, pathlib; from mep_build import _no_intro_sha1 as h; print(h(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])))" <rom> - which returned 96356DA50FF4CD4E3D399181AC19DAFBF298EEA8 (exit 0). The whole file is SHA1 84698B12F4E56A37C67BB47359758124C9B012BB: a plain iNES header (4E 45 53 1A 08 10 10 00), mapper 1 (MMC1), 8 x 16 KB PRG, 16 x 8 KB CHR, 262 160 bytes - the first 16 are the header, and hashing from byte 16 reproduces the No-Intro value exactly. mint-city-slum.txt and city-slum-run.txt were authored and recorded on this dump: the copyright screen, the title's MODE A/B menu and all four stages (the City Slum, the Industrial Area, the Forest and the Hideout of the Boss' gate) are the retail ones, and the four stages are the ones the published RAM selector reaches (navigation.json). The vendored cheat database UI/Dependencies/Internal/CheatDb.Nes.json files the same 003D:01/02/03 codes under 'Double Dragon (USA)' with SHA1 91B3B33A4E24D5DD1A5AFA480B8C44FAC503E926, a different dump: that SHA1 is neither this file's whole-file hash nor its No-Intro payload hash, so the DB's ROM identity was NOT inherited here - what was taken from it is the code and its published wording, which is ADR-0184 s5's requirement, and every figure in this set was measured on THIS dump. Two artifacts on this machine corroborate the No-Intro value independently of the command above: the ROM's library folder ships a '.bootstrap' stamp whose own line reads 'sha1=96356DA50FF4CD4E3D399181AC19DAFBF298EEA8' (with generator=mesence-bootstrap/1, filter=xBRZ, scale=4), and a run of this dump logs '[MEP] pack ... matches ROM sha1 96356DA50FF4CD4E3D399181AC19DAFBF298EEA8'. That folder is also why a bootstrap run pointed at the library path records nothing: '<library>/Double Dragon (1988) (Technos)/' is an auto-only bootstrap pack (textures and audio; a run loaded it as tiles=9495 keys=17687 images=54 backgrounds=287) and the builder declines rather than overwrite it, so the baseline is recorded against a copy inside the unversioned runs/ tree exactly as the sweep records each session. See runs/f1418/doubledragon/RESULT.md.
